headline: Junior Graphic Designer

education.school: Agusan Southern College of Arts and Technology
notes: Thesis exhibit: a visual identity for the Bayugan farmers' market

summary: Junior graphic designer with a year at a print and branding studio. I design logos, packaging, layouts and social media graphics in Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign, and I enjoy working out the idea behind a design before opening the software. I want to grow into brand identity work.

projects.name: Bayugan farmers' market identity
bullets: Designed a logo, colour palette, stall signage and paper bags for a weekend market.
The market adopted the stall signs and bags after the exhibit.

projects.name: Cacao chocolate packaging
projects.description: Packaging for a small tablea and chocolate brand: box, wrapper and labels, printed in a first run of 5,000.

projects.name: Parish fiesta souvenir program
projects.description: A 24-page souvenir program laid out in InDesign, with photos and sponsor ads.

experience.title: Junior Graphic Designer
bullets: Design logos, labels, tarpaulins and menus for about 20 small businesses a month.
Prepare print-ready files and check colours and bleed with the press operator.
Sketch two or three concepts for each brief before moving to the computer.
Present designs to clients and explain the reasoning behind each option.

experience.title: Design Intern
bullets: Designed posters and social media cards for city health and tourism campaigns.
